body:
Types current Learning submission results and completion/continuation capabilities while carrying original saved receipt JSON as an opaque replay value. The backend adapter converts typed values at its existing effect boundary. Stored continuation and unknown fields survive replay, with no new candidate issued for an original receipt.

Based on the local reviewed B14/combined merge 869b50537a711c7aaca6608501118d0717c939ed, which is not yet on the PR base; the visible diff includes upstream integration until that base is published.

Validation on this head: focused Learning/backend suites 145 passed; installed application suite 51 and tooling suite 99 passed. Scoped mypy 1.15.0 strict production and independent submission bindings pass, and an incompatible completion signature fails. The literal full-file command remains incomplete with 83 errors in the backend adapter; the supported runtime interpreter environment reports 80. Models and ports are strict-clean. Remaining issues include independently owned untyped storage/queue/position seams, owner facade exports, nullable fences and identities, and retained JSON at the evidence boundary. No errors were suppressed. Native review/assembled acceptance and independent correctness/Guardian review remain pending; this draft is not source released.


Draft head `3499748d` adds reviewed owner annotations and a typed attempt conversion that preserves nullable admission, original revision and raw receipt bytes. Literal strict mypy still reports 46 errors, so static acceptance is not met. Focused source tests passed as documented in the run ledger; the exact current guard file passes 4/4 after retiring two SPEC-retired R11 assertions and replacing them with current abandonment, identity, nullable, and missing-schema coverage. Existing native abandonment cases have not been run for this head. A missing settings row remains an honestly nullable current owner state; the resulting terminal error path has not been changed or qualified for recovery. Full native, integrated and merge qualification are pending.

At draft head `97ca3c305`, typed receipt insertion validates current identity against its serialized mapping before writing while retaining existing new-result serialization, unknown fields, provisional position payload, and original opaque replay. Independent source review found no actionable issue. Focused adapter tests passed 15/15 and application/boundary tests 51/51; strict mypy still reports 42 errors, and native transaction and integrated proof remain pending.

At draft head `f4e8087c`, calendar capture is published atomically after policy/day calculation, preventing partial same-adapter initialization after an exception. Independent source review found no actionable issue; focused calendar/reconciliation cases passed 4/4 and application/boundary cases 51/51. Two additional gateway cases initially failed on both candidate and unchanged parent because a borrowed installed evidence-math package was stale. With the current evidence-math source on PYTHONPATH, the same five gateway cases passed; this is mocked transport, not native proof. Strict mypy remains failing with 35 errors; native and assembled proof are still required.

Draft head `0368a7b4` also describes the existing latest-review SQL accurately: the valid-only query returns an integer, while the unfiltered query may return `None`. Eight focused cases and 51 application/boundary cases passed; independent source review found no material blocker. Strict mypy remains failing with 33 adapter errors, and native proof remains pending.

At draft head `e17870f2d`, a missing resolved position attempt fails before continuation writes, while valid and recovered attempts retain their original receipt, queue and origin order. Position reconciliation passed 10/10 and checkpoint/reconciliation passed 29/29. Independent source reviews found no material blocker; native rollback and replay are not yet proven. Strict mypy remains failing with 30 adapter errors. The checkpoint type uses the production PostgresConnection, narrower than untyped synthetic test doubles.

Draft head `9b468d54` binds the aggregate review attempt ID to the fenced original position plan before queue and attempt locks. Missing or mismatched IDs now receive the existing 409 conflict; valid lock order and prior receipt replay remain unchanged. Focused checkpoint/reconciliation tests passed 36/36; independent source review found no actionable issue. Strict mypy remains failing with 27 adapter errors. Native lock, rollback, replay and assembled proof are pending.

Draft head `3fc298d5` types the existing requeue storage and application handoff while retaining zero positions, missing-offset fallback, historical origin cycles, write order and caller-owned transaction. Twenty focused requeue and 84 Learning/calendar tests passed; the storage file passes strict mypy, while the adapter still has 25 errors. Independent source review found no actionable issue. Native cycle, rollback and replay proof remains pending.

Draft head `0b6311d89` describes existing queue issuance results, including ordinary, retired, position-hold and replay variants, without changing the wire response. Thirty selected cases and 50 Learning tests passed; three additional cases failed identically on the parent due to a retired fixture API. Independent source review found no actionable issue. Adapter strict mypy still reports 24 errors, and the issuance producer's standalone strict check also remains failing. Native and assembled qualification remain open.

Draft head `33a7def00` passes the same positively validated original evidence completion to revision and persistence owners, preserving nullable public input and original receipt replay. Focused Learning, boundary and position tests passed 71 cases, plus five adapter cases; independent source review found no actionable issue. Strict mypy remains failing with 22 adapter errors; native transaction and replay proof is still required.

Draft head `17813cd25` requires matching original plan, writer fence, validated completion and current saved-review identity before new position effects; the existing owner/source fences and SQL receipt check remain authoritative, and opaque original replay stays separate. Ninety-six focused cases passed; independent source review found no actionable issue. Strict mypy still reports 18 errors; native transaction, race, rollback, replay and assembled proof remain pending.

Draft head `499053b3d` carries checkpoint receipt rows, grade receipts and their original JSON value through an immutable wrapper, preserving existing decoder and writer/source/owner fences, including saved-grade replay under stale source. Malformed identity/event data now becomes an evidence conflict. Independent source review found no actionable blocker; 96 focused cases passed, and an additional JSONB-shaped fake receipt plus checkpoint/reconciliation selection passed 41 cases. Adapter strict mypy remains failing with 14 errors; the checkpoint owner is not fully strict-qualified. Actual PostgreSQL JSONB, atomic rollback and lost-ack replay remain unproven.

Draft head `8d8a78686` distinguishes fresh reconciliation facts from the retained stored receipt text. The adapter preserves the existing normalized response, progression and recovered-origin behavior without rewriting stored receipt bytes; a missing recovered original ID is held. Focused suites passed 127 cases, and independent source review found no actionable issue. Strict mypy still reports 12 adapter errors; the reconciliation owner is not fully strict-qualified, and native receipt/replay and rollback proof remain pending.

Draft head `a17efdc2` types the existing borrowed-transaction acceptance clock, retaining the same query, missing-settings error and original timezone string; malformed driver types now fail closed. Six fake-driver checks passed and independent source review found no material issue. Strict mypy remains failing with 11 adapter errors; the real PostgreSQL clock/transaction proof remains pending.

Draft head `9a926a9b7` carries validated original completion through final evidence and requeue inheritance. Original opaque receipt decoding and failure behavior remain separate; a new-result requeue ID of zero remains valid. Fifteen focused owner cases and 92 Learning/position cases passed, and independent source review found no actionable issue. Adapter strict mypy still reports five errors; native transaction, replay, hold and rollback proof remains pending.

Draft head `80f939d2b` reflects the existing review gateway boundary: dynamically prepared input and an opaque decoded JSON result, including historical scalar, list or null values. It changes annotations only. Forty-five focused gateway/wrapper/replay cases passed; independent source review found no actionable issue. Adapter strict mypy still reports four errors; native gateway proof remains pending.
title: Type Learning submission results and preserve receipt replay
head: codex/completion-b15
